title: K2 Space orbits
description: A 72px two-line title on black, then a pinned stage: a round planet frame inside a thin ring with four tick dots zooms out from three times its size as you scroll in, three square orbit tabs (LEO / MEO / GEO) fade in, and the paragraph under them steps from one orbit to the next as you keep scrolling (crossfade 0.3s). Phones drop the pin: planet, tab row and paragraph stack, and the tabs switch on tap.
notes: desktop (1024px+) pins for about 2.7 windows of scroll; the planet zoom and tab fade are CSS scroll-driven, the active orbit follows the scroll position (JavaScript)
on desktop a tab click scrolls to that orbit's stretch; on phones it switches directly
the planet is a round media slot (video or image); empty it is a dark placeholder disc, never a drawing of a planet
under reduced motion the planet stays at its size and the tabs stay visible
